content.description: Auto Glass Plus is an auto glass shop serving Ocala, FL and the surrounding area. Services include Auto Windshield Repair, Auto Rear Window Replacement, Auto Side Window Replacement, Auto Windshield Replacement. Call (352) 816-7221 for more information.

faqs.a: Yes, we bring our mobile service directly to you throughout Ocala and the surrounding areas. We can typically complete most windshield replacements in under an hour at your preferred location.
faqs.q: Do you offer mobile service to fix my windshield at my home or workplace?

faqs.a: Most comprehensive auto insurance policies cover glass damage with little to no deductible. We handle direct billing with major insurers, so you don't need to pay out of pocket or file claims yourself.
faqs.q: Will my insurance cover auto glass repair or replacement?

faqs.a: We provide a lifetime warranty on our installation workmanship plus the manufacturer's warranty on all glass. If there's ever an issue, we'll make it right.
faqs.q: What warranty do you offer on your work?

faqs.a: Most replacements take 45 minutes to an hour. After installation, we recommend waiting at least one hour before driving and several hours before exposing the vehicle to water or car washes.
faqs.q: How long does a windshield replacement typically take?

faqs.a: We repair chips and small cracks if they're outside the driver's line of sight and meet safety standards. We can discuss options when you call—many repairs cost less than your deductible.
faqs.q: Do you repair chips and cracks or only do full replacements?
